courses.title: You Are Not Your Fault: Meeting ADHD with Mindfulness, Wisdom, and Compassion (Online)
courses.description: A three-hour online half-day retreat, hosted by New York Insight Meditation Center, for people who struggle with focus, follow-through and emotional sensitivity. Mark uses mindfulness, self-compassion and forgiveness practice to meet these patterns, and the shame that often comes with them, with more kindness; registrants receive the recording.

courses.title: Leading with Mindfulness & Wisdom: A Regenerative Training for Environmental Professionals
courses.description: A six-month programme for people working on the environmental crisis, taught with Kristin Barker and Bonnie Duran. It combines Buddhist teaching, nature-based practice and a peer cohort, with two five-night retreats (Mount Madonna Center and Garrison Institute) and monthly online sessions.
